name: Cleansing
overview: Scripture reveals that true cleansing is a spiritual renewal initiated by God, who creates a clean heart and renews a right spirit within us, as expressed in Psalms 51:10. This cleansing comes through the transformative power of God's word, which purifies believers (John 15:3), and is further demonstrated by the renewing of the mind to discern and live according to God's perfect will (Romans 12:2). The call to be perfect as God is perfect (Matthew 5:48) emphasizes the standard of holiness believers are to pursue, while Ezekiel 18:20 underscores individual responsibility for sin and righteousness, highlighting that cleansing is tied to personal repentance and righteousness.
